system.roleplaying: Your innate animalistic nature allows you to identify any type of non-sapient animal life and determine its origin in broad terms, such as Earth, alien, etc.
system.minorTwist: How did your primal nature get the better of you?
system.majorTwist: What is the only way the animal within can be restrained?

greenAbility.name: Principle of Fauna
greenAbility.gameText: Overcome with the aid of local fauna and use your Max die. You and each of your allies gain a hero point.
